name: luz-crawl
description: Evidence-backed multi-source search, research, crawling, verification, and reusable research memory.

interface.shortDescription: Plan, crawl, verify, and preserve research evidence.
interface.longDescription: Luz Crawl automatically inventories available search routes, retrieves relevant persistent experience, executes evidence-backed multi-source research, records fallbacks, and deposits idempotent lessons for future runs.
interface.defaultPrompt: Research this topic with Luz Crawl and produce an evidence-backed source map.
